blocks.text: バレなければ良いといという発想ですこ?
blocks.translation: So you’re saying as long as we don’t get caught, it’s fine?!

blocks.text: そもそも先生と生と生と生徒という関係という発展するというのがそもそもそも挫判されてしかるべきと思いますが
blocks.translation: Honestly, the very idea of a teacher and student developing a relationship should be shut down right from the start!

blocks.text: とはいえ、たとえ真剣なお付き合いをされているのだとしても
blocks.translation: Even if they were in a serious relationship...

blocks.text: お互い立場があるんですから交際も清潔潔白であるべきです
blocks.translation: Since there are clear differences in their positions, any relationship between them must stay pure and clean.

blocks.text: そこは個人間人間に入の人間関係、こというというでものは極限りにいうのは終了から否定され終了されるべきではないでと私は思いと私は思います
blocks.translation: I think personal relationships like that shouldn’t be completely forbidden—there’s no reason to rule them out outright.

blocks.text: 世間に流布されたら役職劇劇奪のうえ橋正局行きは免れない自覚はおありですか?
blocks.translation: Do you realize what would happen if this got out? You’d lose your position and probably end up at the police station!

blocks.text: にもかかわらず責任ある立場の大人が生徒に手を出し
blocks.translation: And yet, an adult in a position of responsibility still tries to get involved with a student...

blocks.text: あまつさえ他人の目が届く場所で行為に行為に及ぶ、
blocks.translation: On top of that, they do it in a place where anyone could see them—

blocks.text: キヴォトスの治安の守護者たるヴァルキューレ公安局の副局長が
blocks.translation: The deputy head of Valkyrie Public Security Bureau, who’s supposed to protect Kivotos’ peace...

blocks.text: こ、子どもができるような行為に及ぶなんて
blocks.translation: How dare you even think about having kids together like that?!

blocks.text: ......つまり見つまり見つからず
blocks.translation: I mean, as long as we don’t get caught...

blocks.text: ゴムもすれば問題はー
blocks.translation: If we use a condom, then there’s no problem—

blocks.text: あるに決まってるでしょ!
blocks.translation: Of course there is! It’s obvious!

blocks.text: 離婚姻は意図せぬ左族の可能性があるんです!
blocks.translation: Marriage could lead to unwanted complications and scandal!

blocks.text: でもコノカといちゃいちゃいちゃしたくなったら
blocks.translation: But what if I suddenly feel like getting cozy with Konoka? What then?

blocks.text: ムラムフしたらどうしたらすればいのさ
blocks.translation: What should I do if I get turned on?!

blocks.text: 手を襲いだりキスしたりするでしょ
blocks.translation: You’d end up touching her or kissing her, right?

blocks.text: 勝手に自愚でもしてください!
blocks.translation: Just go ahead and do whatever you want then! Leave me out of it!

blocks.text: だろそろ
blocks.translation: Right about time...

blocks.text: 肌の接触触は控えるべきです!
blocks.translation: We should avoid any physical contact!

blocks.text: でも大人と生徒がお付き合いする
blocks.translation: But what if an adult and a student start dating?...

blocks.text: でも手も手も香も地続きの肌だよ
blocks.translation: Their skin is still so close—literally touching each other.

blocks.text: その言葉は正しいと思いますけど
blocks.translation: I agree with that point, but...

blocks.text: 性交渉は
blocks.translation: Sexual intercourse...

blocks.text: 恋愛に年の差なんで
blocks.translation: There’s no age difference in love...

blocks.text: 徹度をもって
blocks.translation: We need to be careful...

blocks.text: そんなヘリクツを
blocks.translation: Don’t talk nonsense like that!

blocks.text: だああああああ
blocks.translation: AAAAAAAH!!
